title: Ask
body: Post the change in your website channel. Links, photos and PDFs all work.

title: Draft
body: The right sheep makes it on a private copy. Your live site isn't touched.

title: Check
body: Every change is tested: links, speed, accessibility and the phone layout.

title: Preview
body: A preview link and screenshots arrive in the thread, usually within minutes.

title: Approve
body: Press publish and it's live in under a minute. Undo lasts seven days.
